body.statement: A feasible finite-dimensional linear program with finite optimal value and its feasible dual attain equal optimal values; optimal primal and dual solutions are characterized by complementary slackness.

source.locator: Appendix A, Theorem A.2 and Corollary A.3
source.verbatim_statement: If the LPs (P) and (D) are feasible, then for any optimal solution x* to (P) and any optimal solution y* to (D), ∑ⱼ cⱼx*ⱼ = ∑ᵢ bᵢy*ᵢ.
